test_queries.label: Date Range Query
test_queries.query: What photos and notes do I have from June and July 2026?
test_queries.description: Core use case — multi-month span covering both photo dates (June) and note dates (July)

test_queries.label: Entity-Specific Query
test_queries.query: Show me beach photos and any notes about the beach
test_queries.description: Entity-focused retrieval — should return photos with Beach entity and notes mentioning Beach

test_queries.label: Long Natural Language (Audio Transcription Simulation)
test_queries.query: Hey so I was thinking about that trip we took to St Pete back in June you know the one where we went to the beach and saw that crazy sunset and I wanted to compare that with the notes I wrote on July 22nd about the bike ride downtown and whether it rained that evening
test_queries.description: Simulates a long voice transcription — tests whether keyword extraction can handle a rambling 60+ word query
